seo.title: Ship Design, Marine R&D & Software Capabilities | LASAN MARINE
seo.description: Explore our ship design experience, research work, specialist software stack and custom software capabilities across vessel design, simulation, measurement and digital systems.

fields.headline: Capability is easier to judge when you can see the work behind it
fields.lead: More than 300 vessel design packages show the range of ship-design work our team has handled. Alongside that record are 20+ scientific publications and a software practice covering management systems, websites, automation and applied AI.

fields.heading: Ship design is our core discipline, supported by R&D and software

items.name: Ship Design
items.desc: Newbuild and conversion design for wood, steel and composite vessels, from concept development and hydrostatics to structures, propulsion and technical drawings.

items.name: Research & Development
items.desc: Research, simulation and measurement for questions involving hydrodynamics, structures, vibration, propulsion and geometry, with methods selected around the question being investigated.

items.name: Software
items.desc: Custom software for management, websites, workflow automation and AI-enabled applications. Public calculators and lookup tools are only a small part of this wider software capability.

children.name: Applied AI for defined use cases

fields.caption: Ship Design
fields.heading: Experience across vessel types, hull materials and design problems
fields.body: Our project record includes fishing vessels, fisheries support vessels, passenger craft and inland-waterway vessels in wood, steel and composite. The work ranges from newbuild and conversion design to specialist calculations and as-built technical documentation.

items.text: Hydrostatics, stability, resistance, structures and propulsion

fields.heading: Specialist tools used across our work
fields.note: We use established software for hull modelling, design calculations, propeller work, CFD and structural analysis, alongside internal automation tools developed for recurring design tasks.

fields.heading: Looking for experience relevant to your vessel or technical problem?
fields.description: Send us the vessel type, the work you need done or the technical issue you are dealing with. We will compare it with our project record and explain where our experience is most relevant.
